name: Style Transfer
author: hearth-team
description: Restyle an existing image with a new aesthetic — pass `image_url` of the source + `style` describing the target look (e.g. 'watercolour wash', 'cyberpunk neon', '1920s film grain'). Subject and composition stay; surface treatment shifts.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.
